## Objective

Describe the technical problem or gap (not a vague wish list).

## Proposed solution

Clear description of the desired API, mode, test, or build change.

## Implementation considerations

- Fit with MCU defaults (CTR+TDES, opt-in modes)
- Code size / RAM impact
- Compatibility with existing `DES_*` APIs
- Sister-project alignment ([tiny-AES-c](https://github.com/mistial-dev/tiny-AES-c))

## Testing / validation

How the change would be verified (unit tests, CAVP, edge vectors, size).

## Additional context

Links to standards, vectors, or prior discussion.
